uutiset.t: Hedge Funds’ $1 Billion Arbitrage Win in Cayman Is Under Threat
uutiset.s: Investment firms that reaped a $1 billion award on a bet challenging the $2.59 billion take-private deal for China’s Sina Corp. now face the possibility that they’ll never be paid.

uutiset.s: Kate Moore, chief investment officer at Citi Wealth, says she’s not ready to call an “all clear” on markets, but doesn’t see anything to make her cut back her equity exposure. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.s: Weakening gasoline means profits may have peaked.

uutiset.s: The Brazilian real tumbled past 6 reais per dollar, extending a post-election selloff fueled by concerns over the country’s fiscal outlook.

uutiset.t: Poland’s IPO Rush Builds as Defense Firms Join Listings Wave
uutiset.s: Poland’s IPO revival is gathering momentum, as companies tied to the country’s record military buildup bolster the listings pipeline.

uutiset.s: Top cobalt producer Democratic Republic of Congo will reintroduce a ban on exports of the battery metal from the end of the month, in an effort to reverse slumping prices.

uutiset.t: Wall Street Surges Toward M&A Record as Megadeals Defy Selloff

uutiset.t: Refinery in Southern Russia Halts Operations After Attack
